name: Princeton Digital SAT Mock Test · Vocabulary
subtitle: Words & options from Module 1 and Module 2

words.defn_en: dangerous; likely to cause harm

sentences.en: Workers must wear masks when handling ______ chemicals.
sentences.zh: 處理「危險的」化學物質時，工人必須戴口罩。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: (of a volcano) able to erupt; busy doing things

sentences.en: Scientists watch the ______ volcano closely for signs of an eruption.
sentences.zh: 科學家密切觀察這座「活」火山是否有噴發跡象。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: having many mountains

sentences.en: Travel is slow in ______ regions where roads twist around steep peaks.
sentences.zh: 在道路繞著陡峭山峰的「多山」地區，交通很緩慢。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: far away from towns and people

sentences.en: The village is so ______ that the mail arrives only once a week.
sentences.zh: 那個村莊非常「偏遠」，郵件一週只送來一次。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: following customs that have existed for a long time

sentences.en: My grandmother still cooks ______ dishes for the Lunar New Year.
sentences.zh: 我的祖母過農曆新年時仍然煮「傳統的」菜餚。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: not well known

sentences.en: The author's first novel remained ______ until a famous director turned it into a film.
sentences.zh: 這位作家的第一部小說一直「鮮為人知」，直到一位知名導演把它拍成電影。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: careful not to attract attention

sentences.en: Please be ______ and don't tell anyone about the surprise party.
sentences.zh: 請「低調」一點，不要告訴任何人這場驚喜派對。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: strange or unusual in behavior

sentences.en: The ______ artist painted only while standing on one foot.
sentences.zh: 那位「古怪的」藝術家只在單腳站立時作畫。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: following official rules and customs

sentences.en: Guests at the ______ dinner were asked to wear suits and gowns.
sentences.zh: 參加「正式」晚宴的賓客被要求穿西裝和禮服。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: full of busy activity and people

sentences.en: The ______ night market was crowded with shoppers and food stalls.
sentences.zh: 「熱鬧的」夜市擠滿了購物人潮和小吃攤。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: not able to be known in advance

sentences.en: Mountain weather is ______, so always bring a raincoat.
sentences.zh: 山上的天氣「難以預測」，所以一定要帶雨衣。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: empty; with no people

sentences.en: After midnight, the train station was completely ______.
sentences.zh: 午夜過後，火車站完全「空無一人」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: a typical quality or feature

sentences.en: Long ears are a key ______ of this rabbit breed.
sentences.zh: 長耳朵是這種兔子品種的主要「特徵」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: the chance of future success

sentences.en: Learning English can improve your job ______s.
sentences.zh: 學英文能改善你的工作「前景」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: the ability to produce the desired result

sentences.en: Doctors tested the ______ of the new medicine on 500 patients.
sentences.zh: 醫生在 500 名病人身上測試新藥的「功效」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: a bad effect or result of an action

sentences.en: Cheating on the exam had serious ______s for his future.
sentences.zh: 考試作弊對他的未來造成了嚴重的「後果」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to collect or gather into one group or amount

sentences.en: The app ______s news from many websites into one page.
sentences.zh: 這個應用程式把許多網站的新聞「彙集」到同一頁。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to gradually disappear or spread out

sentences.en: The morning fog began to ______ as the sun rose.
sentences.zh: 太陽升起時，晨霧開始「消散」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: (of liquid) to pass slowly through something

sentences.en: Rainwater ______s through the soil and reaches underground streams.
sentences.zh: 雨水「滲透」過土壤，流入地下水流。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to work together with others

sentences.en: Students ______d on a science project about clean water.
sentences.zh: 學生們「合作」完成一個關於乾淨用水的科學專題。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to support or confirm with evidence

sentences.en: Two witnesses ______d the driver's story.
sentences.zh: 兩名目擊者「證實」了司機的說法。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to officially show that someone is not guilty

sentences.en: New evidence helped ______ the man who had been wrongly accused.
sentences.zh: 新證據幫助「證明」那名被誤控的男子「無罪」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to explain something by describing its background situation
words.defn_zh: 把……置於背景脈絡中理解

sentences.en: The museum guide ______d the painting by describing life in 1800s Paris.
sentences.zh: 博物館導覽員描述 1800 年代巴黎的生活，把這幅畫「置於背景脈絡中」說明。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to suggest something as true as a basis for reasoning

sentences.en: Scientists ______ that the planet may have water beneath its ice.
sentences.zh: 科學家「假定」這顆行星的冰層下可能有水。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to describe the typical qualities of

sentences.en: Critics ______ her music as calm and hopeful.
sentences.zh: 評論家把她的音樂「形容為」平靜而充滿希望。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to clearly show a feeling or quality

sentences.en: His careful notes ______d a deep interest in the subject.
sentences.zh: 他仔細的筆記「顯示出」他對這個科目的濃厚興趣。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to leave out or omit

sentences.en: The summary ______d many small details to stay short.
sentences.zh: 這份摘要「省略」了許多小細節以保持簡短。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to measure or judge something

sentences.en: Teachers use quizzes to ______ how much students have learned.
sentences.zh: 老師用小考來「判斷」學生學了多少。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to work together on something

sentences.en: Two companies will ______ a new electric car.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司將「合作」開發一款新電動車。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to give official power or authority to

sentences.en: Judges are ______ the power to interpret the law.
sentences.zh: 法官「被授予」解釋法律的權力。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to secretly plan to harm someone

sentences.en: In the play, the king's brother ______ him.
sentences.zh: 在劇中，國王的弟弟「密謀反對」他。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to gain knowledge or skill by studying something

sentences.en: Good players ______ their mistakes.
sentences.zh: 好的球員會從錯誤中「學習」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: something you plan to do

sentences.en: She has no ______ of quitting the team.
sentences.zh: 她沒有退出球隊的「打算」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: a list of things to be discussed at a meeting

sentences.en: The first item on the ______ is the school trip.
sentences.zh: 「議程」上的第一項是校外教學。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: something that takes your attention away

sentences.en: Music can be a ______ when you are studying math.
sentences.zh: 讀數學時，音樂可能是一種「干擾」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: a particular way of doing something

sentences.en: The coach showed us a new breathing ______ for swimming.
sentences.zh: 教練教我們一種新的游泳換氣「技巧」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: the act of passing something from one to another

sentences.en: Washing hands reduces the ______ of germs.
sentences.zh: 洗手能減少細菌的「傳播」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: a feeling of being sure of yourself

sentences.en: Practicing every day gave him the ______ to speak in public.
sentences.zh: 每天練習給了他公開演講的「信心」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: the act of making something last longer

sentences.en: The ______ of the summer vacation made students happy.
sentences.zh: 暑假的「延長」讓學生很開心。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: great damage or destruction

sentences.en: The earthquake left ______ across the city.
sentences.zh: 地震在全市留下了「嚴重的破壞」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to a much greater degree than others

sentences.en: Air pollution ______ affects children and the elderly.
sentences.zh: 空氣污染「不成比例地」影響兒童和老人。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: only; not including anything else

sentences.en: This parking lot is ______ for teachers.
sentences.zh: 這個停車場「專門」給老師使用。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: basically; in the most important ways

sentences.en: The two phones are ______ the same, except for color.
sentences.zh: 這兩支手機除了顏色以外「基本上」一樣。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: at first; at the beginning

sentences.en: ______, I didn't like spicy food, but now I love it.
sentences.zh: 「起初」我不喜歡辣的食物，但現在很愛。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to make something seem less important than it is

sentences.en: Don't ______ your friend's worries by laughing at them.
sentences.zh: 不要嘲笑朋友的煩惱而「輕視」它們。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to explain or show with pictures or examples

sentences.en: The teacher used a map to ______ the route of the explorers.
sentences.zh: 老師用地圖來「說明」探險家的路線。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to reject an idea as not worth considering

sentences.en: Scientists ______ed the rumor as false.
sentences.zh: 科學家「駁斥」這個謠言是假的。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to encourage or support something

sentences.en: The campaign aims to ______ healthy eating in schools.
sentences.zh: 這項活動旨在「推廣」校園健康飲食。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to give out to many people

sentences.en: Volunteers ______d food to families after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後，志工「分發」食物給家庭。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: to make something more noticeable or important

sentences.en: The speaker ______d the importance of sleep.
sentences.zh: 演講者「強調」睡眠的重要性。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–7 & Module 2 Q1–6)

words.defn_en: involving people of different ages or generations

sentences.en: The ______ choir has singers from age 8 to 80.
sentences.zh: 這個「跨世代」合唱團的團員從 8 歲到 80 歲都有。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: not physical; unable to be touched

sentences.en: Friendship is an ______ treasure.
sentences.zh: 友誼是一種「無形的」寶藏。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a large crowd of people

sentences.en: ______s of fans waited outside the stadium.
sentences.zh: 「大批」粉絲在體育場外等候。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: something that blocks progress

sentences.en: Lack of money was the biggest ______ to his dream.
sentences.zh: 缺錢是他實現夢想最大的「障礙」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: how often something happens

sentences.en: The ______ of flu rises in winter.
sentences.zh: 流感的「發生率」在冬天上升。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: an official right to be the only one to make or sell an invention

sentences.en: She got a ______ for her new kind of bicycle lock.
sentences.zh: 她為她的新型腳踏車鎖取得了「專利」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a large natural or artificial lake used to store water

sentences.en: The city gets its drinking water from a ______ in the hills.
sentences.zh: 這座城市的飲用水來自山上的「水庫」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: very convincing or interesting
words.defn_zh: 令人信服的；引人入勝的

sentences.en: The lawyer presented ______ evidence.
sentences.zh: 律師提出了「令人信服的」證據。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: including and welcoming all kinds of people

sentences.en: Our club tries to be ______ of students from every background.
sentences.zh: 我們的社團努力「包容」各種背景的學生。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: always; without exception

sentences.en: He ______ arrives five minutes early.
sentences.zh: 他「總是」提早五分鐘到。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: beyond what is normal or natural

sentences.en: The puppy was ______ calm during the thunderstorm.
sentences.zh: 小狗在雷雨中「異常地」冷靜。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: caused by human activity

sentences.en: ______ pollution has harmed many rivers.
sentences.zh: 「人為」污染已傷害了許多河流。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: waste material; garbage

sentences.en: Seagulls search the harbor for ______ from fishing boats.
sentences.zh: 海鷗在港口尋找漁船丟棄的「廢物」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: nearness in space or time

sentences.en: The hotel's ______ to the beach makes it popular.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店「靠近」海灘，所以很受歡迎。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a person who supports an idea

sentences.en: She is a strong ______ of free public libraries.
sentences.zh: 她是免費公共圖書館的堅定「支持者」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: causing a lot of disagreement

sentences.en: The new rule about phones was ______ among students.
sentences.zh: 關於手機的新規定在學生之間「頗具爭議」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: related to the sky or outer space

sentences.en: Stars and planets are ______ bodies.
sentences.zh: 恆星和行星都是「天體」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a red, swollen, painful condition in part of the body

sentences.en: Ice can reduce ______ after a sports injury.
sentences.zh: 冰敷可以減輕運動傷害後的「發炎」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: the surgical removal of a body part

sentences.en: After the accident, doctors had to perform an ______ of his leg.
sentences.zh: 意外發生後，醫生不得不為他的腿進行「截肢」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a difficult choice between two options

sentences.en: She faced a ______: study for the test or go to her friend's party.
sentences.zh: 她面臨「兩難」：準備考試還是去朋友的派對。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: not based on reason or logic

sentences.en: His fear of butterflies is ______.
sentences.zh: 他對蝴蝶的恐懼是「不理性的」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a journey to a holy place

sentences.en: Every year, millions make a ______ to the temple.
sentences.zh: 每年有數百萬人到這座寺廟「朝聖」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: new and experimental, especially in art

sentences.en: The ______ concert used sounds from kitchen pots.
sentences.zh: 這場「前衛」音樂會使用了廚房鍋具的聲音。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: to completely destroy or get rid of

sentences.en: Vaccines helped ______ smallpox.
sentences.zh: 疫苗幫助「根除」了天花。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a set of three related books or films

sentences.en: I finished the whole fantasy ______ in one week.
sentences.zh: 我一週內就讀完了整套奇幻「三部曲」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: not owned or demanded by anyone
words.defn_zh: 無人認領的；無人宣稱主權的

sentences.en: The lost-and-found box is full of ______ umbrellas.
sentences.zh: 失物招領箱裡滿是「無人認領的」雨傘。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: to combine resources or efforts with others

sentences.en: The friends ______ed their money to buy a gift.
sentences.zh: 朋友們「集資」買了一份禮物。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to use something fully for an advantage

sentences.en: Solar panels ______ the energy of sunlight.
sentences.zh: 太陽能板「利用」陽光的能量。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: a disturbance that stops something from continuing normally

sentences.en: The storm caused a ______ to train service.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨造成火車服務「中斷」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: food and drink that keeps living things alive

sentences.en: The desert offers little ______ for animals.
sentences.zh: 沙漠能提供給動物的「食物」很少。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: lasting for a long time or happening often

sentences.en: He has ______ back pain from sitting all day.
sentences.zh: 他整天久坐，患有「慢性」背痛。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: a member of the highest social class

sentences.en: The ______ lived in a castle with fifty rooms.
sentences.zh: 那位「貴族」住在有五十個房間的城堡裡。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to stop something before it reaches its goal

sentences.en: The goalkeeper ______ed the ball.
sentences.zh: 守門員「攔截」了球。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: a misunderstanding

sentences.en: She was under the ______ that the test was on Friday.
sentences.zh: 她「誤以為」考試在星期五。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to think carefully before deciding

sentences.en: The judges ______d for an hour before choosing a winner.
sentences.zh: 評審「仔細考慮」了一小時才選出優勝者。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: planting trees on land that had no forest

sentences.en: ______ projects can help reduce carbon in the air.
sentences.zh: 「造林」計畫能幫助減少空氣中的碳。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: a happy but sad feeling when thinking about the past

sentences.en: Old songs fill my parents with ______.
sentences.zh: 老歌讓我的父母充滿「懷舊」之情。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: the quality of being real or true to oneself

sentences.en: Fans love the singer's ______ on stage.
sentences.zh: 粉絲喜愛這位歌手在台上的「真誠」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: giving the wrong idea

sentences.en: The ad was ______ because the toy was much smaller in real life.
sentences.zh: 這則廣告有「誤導性」，因為玩具實際上小得多。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: the main character in a story

sentences.en: The ______ of the novel is a brave young farmer.
sentences.zh: 這部小說的「主角」是一位勇敢的年輕農夫。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: fair; not favoring one side

sentences.en: A referee must be ______.
sentences.zh: 裁判必須「公正」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: causing harm

sentences.en: Too much screen time can be ______ to your eyes.
sentences.zh: 螢幕使用時間太長可能對眼睛「有害」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: equal in value or effect

sentences.en: One kilogram is ______ to 1,000 grams.
sentences.zh: 一公斤「等於」1,000 公克。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: the state of no longer existing

sentences.en: Many frog species face ______.
sentences.zh: 許多蛙類面臨「滅絕」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: related to earthquakes

sentences.en: ______ waves travel through the earth.
sentences.zh: 「地震」波在地球內部傳播。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: spread out over a wide area

sentences.en: The village's houses are widely ______ across the valley.
sentences.zh: 村子的房屋「分散」在整個山谷中。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: the process of becoming worse

sentences.en: The old bridge showed signs of ______.
sentences.zh: 這座舊橋出現了「老化」的跡象。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to reduce the effect of something by acting against it

sentences.en: Exercise can ______ the effects of stress.
sentences.zh: 運動可以「抵消」壓力的影響。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: not able to spread from person to person

sentences.en: Diabetes is a ______ disease.
sentences.zh: 糖尿病是一種「非傳染性」疾病。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: giving money to someone to make them act dishonestly

sentences.en: The official was arrested for ______.
sentences.zh: 那名官員因「賄賂」被逮捕。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: twisted together; closely connected

sentences.en: The kite string got ______ in the tree.
sentences.zh: 風箏線「纏」在樹上。
